note: RFC 4271 Section 9.1.4 requires the Decision Process to consider both overlapping routes based on the configured acceptance policy. Reactor TestRFC4271OverlappingRoutesAcceptedByPolicyBothReachTheDecisionProcess and TestRFC4271OverlappingRouteRejectedByPolicyIsNotConsidered drive notifyMessageReceiver through runIngressPolicyChain with overlapping /8 and /24 routes, verifying both reach the RIB when accepted and only the accepted route reaches it when the /24 is rejected. RIB receive tests verify both overlapping routes enter Decision Process and neither arrival order withdraws the other.
